decision.name: CORRECT_JSONL_PARTIAL_RECORD_ORACLE
decision.finding: The previous A 21:05 partial-record acceptance spec was too broad: storage.append_observations writes the entire JSON body then newline, and storage.load_observations strips each line before json.loads. A flushed COMPLETE JSON body without its newline is valid and load_observations can parse it; it does NOT itself prove a ValueError. Actual mid-body truncation (or concatenated complete JSON bodies from an interleaving append) is needed to test malformed-row visibility. Normal TextIO buffering means the fault injection must explicitly flush/fsync the selected prefix. This is a corrected test oracle, not a production failure.

cases: Use multiprocessing.get_context('spawn'), top-level child entrypoints, tmp_path/observations.jsonl and deterministic FlowObservation fixtures; bound Barrier/Event waits and joins, terminate stragglers, propagate child errors and exit codes.

Same-ID two-writer: coordinate the first load_observations post-read snapshot across processes with a bounded Barrier; permit BrokenBarrierError when legitimate serialization blocks the second reader. Final archive MUST contain exactly one unique valid row. Distinct-ID/economic identity control MUST contain exactly two valid rows.

Corrected mid-BODY fault injection: in writer A process only, wrap its archive append write and write a prefix of serialized JSON ending after a colon (invalid JSON), flush+fsync and signal parent, pause before writing the rest. Launch reader B while A is paused. A correct archive reader/lock must never expose a malformed record or throw invalid observation JSONL; release A in finally, then assert complete final JSONL. Do not confuse this forced mid-body window with normal buffered I/O.

Separate complete-BODY/no-newline case: flush+fsync a complete JSON body and pause before newline. Assert direct json.loads of the complete body SUCCEEDS; if a second writer is allowed to append before A's newline, require final archive lines to remain separately parseable (no `}{` concatenation). A ValueError before newline is NOT the acceptance oracle.

Keep corrected two-writer generation test lock-aware: B may legitimately block until A releases; distinguish producer three-file diagnostic from the actual single-atomic-handoff consumer. Do not assert cross-file atomicity is required by the deployed reader.
runnable_no_network_contract.pass_rule: Only an authorized exact-SHA isolated checkout counts; record SHA, source/overlay hashes, stdout/stderr and exit codes. Fail on duplicates, malformed final JSONL, unhandled reader errors, hangs or lost records; report fault-injection vs observed-production separately.
